findings.title: Launched Ground Zero terrain is wall-dominated; enclosed-wall darkness blacks out ~47% of the centered view
findings.expected: Java: Ground Zero launches the stored designed map via the preset's FileMapGenerator (SectorPresets.java:22 groundZero; SectorPreset.java:83-85; World.java:269-272), i.e. mostly open snowy terrain with the core and copper ore; darkness (enableDarkness, Vars.java:218) only blackens enclosed static-wall interiors

findings.repro: scenario campaign_launch step 4 (Play > Campaign > Serpulo > OK > Ground Zero > Resume; exact EV-0012 repro)
notes: Upstream Ground Zero is a stored designed map (core/assets/maps/serpulo/groundZero.msav) loaded by the preset FileMapGenerator (SectorPreset.java:83-85), not a SerpuloPlanetGenerator output (World.java:269-272 picks preset.generator when sector.preset != null); the port ships the same assets/maps/serpulo/groundZero.msav, so the 82%-wall launched composition may be generator/map-load coverage rather than a darkness-render regression.
